description: This file contains utility functions for parsing and reading HTTP request data in a FastAPI application, including JSON body parsing, form data handling, request header and query parameter access, file size validation, and extraction of path parameters. It also includes functions for handling uploaded files and populating request data with path parameters.

methods.name: Dict _read_request_body(request: Optional[Request])
methods.description: Safely reads and parses the request body as JSON, handling different content types and surrogate pair errors, with caching of parsed data.

methods.name: Optional[dict] _safe_get_request_parsed_body(request: Optional[Request])
methods.description: Retrieves cached parsed request body from request scope if available.

methods.name: Dict _safe_get_request_query_params(request: Optional[Request])
methods.description: Safely retrieves query parameters from the request.

methods.name: None _safe_set_request_parsed_body( request: Optional[Request], parsed_body: dict, )
methods.description: Caches the parsed request body into the request scope.

methods.name: dict _safe_get_request_headers(request: Optional[Request])
methods.description: Safely retrieves headers from the request.

methods.name: bool check_file_size_under_limit( request_data: dict, file: UploadFile, router_model_names: Collection[str], )
methods.description: Checks if an uploaded file size is within the limit based on deployment configuration and user premium status, raising exceptions if not.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_form_data(request: Request)
methods.description: Reads form data from the request, combining multi-valued keys properly.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] convert_upload_files_to_file_data( form_data: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Converts FastAPI UploadFile objects in form data to tuples of filename, content, and content_type for downstream processing.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_request_body(request: Request)
methods.description: Determines and reads the request body based on content type, segregating JSON and form data.

methods.name: List[str] get_tags_from_request_body(request_body: dict)
methods.description: Extracts tags from the request body metadata, combining 'tags' fields from different places.

methods.name: dict populate_request_with_path_params( request_data: dict, request: Request )
methods.description: Merges URL path parameters into the request data dict, directly or through URL parsing.

methods.name: None _add_vector_store_id_from_path(request_data: dict, request: Request)
methods.description: Extracts 'vector_store_id' from URL path segments and updates the request data accordingly.

ctags.name: check_file_size_under_limit
ctags.signature: ( request_data: dict, file: UploadFile, router_model_names: Collection[str], )
